spec_match.rationale: Rebuilt in this refile to run the tone inside a real AudioWorkletProcessor whose stress load is genuine per-process() DSP work, with deadline overruns measured inside the worklet (render time vs block budget) — no more main-thread simulation.

interactive.rationale: Hint buttons restart the session live, the stress slider posts real load into the worklet, start/stop manage lifecycle, and metrics/waveform/glitch log update continuously.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card's promise matches the page's verified behaviour.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinct honest branches for no AudioContext, no AudioWorklet, worklet-module load failure, constructor rejection of the hint (itself flagged as a finding), and missing renderQuantumSize ('not exposed' plus explanation).

references.rationale: The page has no see-also section (matching its v151 layout); the feature index one click up carries the ChromeStatus entry and spec links.

conformance.rationale: The new v153 feature suite ran in the verification browser at 5 pass / 4 fail / 0 blocked — the 4 fails are the shipped-attribute assertions, the honest 'not yet shipped' answer on Chromium 141 (anticipated Chrome 153), exactly as their descriptions state.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP page-driver run (headless Chromium 141 with autoplay permitted): session started with honest 'not exposed' quantum, real worklet callbacks counted (~336-352/s), stress slider moved to 80 live, stop cleanly logged the worklet-reported overrun total; console/network clean; screenshot v153-rq-lab.png read. Headless null-sink renders fast, so zero overruns occurred here.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts rq-lab-started/rq-lab-stopped with hint, quantum, and glitch count, plus distinct ids for the no-AudioContext, no-worklet, and module-load-failure branches.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout (including the pre-existing --demo-color token for the scope background); small emerald log text darkened via color-mix for AA.

accessibility.rationale: Glitch log is role=log aria-live=polite with an aria-label; stress slider has an aria-label and text readout; metrics are text; canvas has an aria-label.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check v153/webaudio-configurable-render-quantum --no-server: desktop OK clean, mobile OK (sub-44px flags are inline links, primary buttons/sliders remain usable); both screenshots read and judged clean.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify on a build where the Chrome 153 flip has landed
openQuestions.detail: The verification browser (Chromium 141, no origin trial) does not expose renderQuantumSize, so every hint is honestly reported as ignored. Once a Chrome 153 stable (or a build launched with --enable-blink-features=WebAudioConfigurableRenderQuantum) is available, re-run the page and confirm the quantum readouts flip to real values and the four not-yet conformance assertions pass.

openQuestions.title: Demonstrate the glitch-count comparison across quanta on real hardware
openQuestions.detail: The lab's whole premise — fewer overruns at larger quanta under the same load — needs a machine where the audio thread can actually miss deadlines and a browser that honours the hint. Capture comparative counts (128 vs 512 vs hardware) once both are available.

guidanceConsulted.query: web audio start stop controls live metrics readout accessibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give async result areas polite live regions, keep state changes textual, and disable/re-enable controls around async work.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Glitch log made a labelled role=log live region; all state changes have textual equivalents.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Driver run: start/stop entries announced in the log

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let card grids collapse to one column on narrow viewports and keep wide code blocks scrolling inside their own container.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: lab-layout collapses to one column under 640px; canvas is width:100%.

summary: v153 refile with the page's core defect fixed: the v151 copy 'detected glitches' from main-thread setInterval gaps while the stress slider did nothing — this version runs a real AudioWorklet whose slider-driven load is genuine DSP work and whose deadline overruns are measured inside process(). Verified via CDP headless Chromium 141 with autoplay permitted: real callbacks counted, live stress changes, honest quantum readout, clean console/network.
